children: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., Ltd. Sponsored ADR (TWSE:2330) is accelerating its 2nm ramp and U.S. mega‑fab buildout — lifting end‑2026 capacity targets, boosting FY2026 revenue outlook on N2, CoWoS and higher wafer prices — while investors eye AI demand, margins and 2027 cloud guidance.
Previous Week Recap
2nm Rollout Accelerates Capacity
: Taiwan Semiconductor (2330) sped up 2nm rollout, boosting end-2026 capacity target to ~120,000 wafers/month (from 100,000) and reporting 10–20% higher 2nm orders from key customers
Q2 Revenue $40.2B, Up 34%
: TSMC (2330) Q2 revenue $40.2B, +34% YoY, +12% QoQ. Company says FY2026 revenue growth ~43%, citing N2 ramp, higher wafer prices and added CoWoS capacity.
Q3 Results Oct. 15 Preview
: Taiwan Semiconductor (2330) reports Q3 results Oct. 15. Traders focus on AI demand exposure and any guidance/comments on cloud customers’ 2027 spending that could affect near-term revenue.
Arizona Buildout Planned
: Taiwan Semiconductor (2330) plans a major Arizona buildout: six logic fabs, two packaging plants and a new R&D center; about 30% of its 2nm+ capacity may end up in Arizona.
U.S. Megacampus, 2nm Ramp
: TSMC (2330) is exploring U.S. mega-campus sites, ramping 2nm, expanding advanced packaging and overseas fabs. High utilization and multi-year 2nm commitments may pressure near-term gross margins.
High-NA Lithography Roadmap
: TSMC (2330) unveiled a High-NA lithography roadmap toward advanced nodes: two-stage rollout, six-inch mask start, joint ASML 12-inch pilot in 2031 and production-ready systems by 2033.
Options Impvol ~30%, Low Short Interest
: TSMC (2330) options show implied volatility near 30%, put-call ratio about 0.80, and short interest under 1% of float, reflecting current options pricing and low shorting activity
Valuation Cited, AI Rally
: Taiwan Semiconductor (2330) rose ~0.9% as JPMorgan noted lower valuations boost upside potential but warned valuation alone won’t revive the chip cycle; rally tied to renewed AI stock interest.
Synopsys Partnership Expanded

: TSMC (2330) expanded its Synopsys partnership to add AI-assisted design, automated chiplet layout, advanced packaging power analysis and co-packaged optics verification ahead of its A14 process ramp.
